cases.explain: The preposition перед ("before/in front of") always governs the Instrumental case, so почтмейстер becomes почтмейстером.

cases.sentence: Ваш припадок испугал нас вчера с ___
cases.translation: Your fit scared us yesterday, me and the doctor.
cases.explain: The preposition с ("with") governs the Instrumental case, so доктор becomes доктором.

cases.translation: Go lie down in the hospital.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into governs the Accusative case, so больница becomes больницу.

cases.sentence: Я нашел во всем городе одного только умного ___
cases.translation: In the whole town I found only one intelligent person.
cases.explain: Человека is the direct object of the transitive verb нашел ("found") and is animate, so it takes the Genitive-like Accusative ending -а.

cases.translation: Nikita came in with an armful of a robe.
cases.explain: "Охапка (чего?) халата" — the noun describing what the armful consists of takes the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Андрей Ефимович сидел на кровати Ивана Дмитриевича и ждал ___
cases.translation: Andrei Yefimych sat on Ivan Dmitrich's bed and waited for Khobotov.
cases.explain: The verb ждать governs the Genitive case for a person, so Хоботов becomes Хоботова.

cases.translation: Nikita punched him in the face with his fist.
cases.explain: The preposition по governing the target of a strike takes the Dative case, so лицо becomes лицу.

cases.sentence: Недалеко от больничного забора в ста саженях стоял высокий белый дом, обнесенный каменной ___
cases.translation: Not far from the hospital fence, about a hundred sazhens away, stood a tall white house, enclosed by a stone wall.
cases.explain: The instrument/means by which the house is enclosed is expressed by the Instrumental case, so стена becomes стеной.

reading.ru: По уходе гостей Андрей Ефимович, дрожа как в лихорадке, лег на диван и долго еще повторял «Тупые люди, глупые люди».
reading.question: What did Andrei Yefimych do right after his guests left?
options: He lay on the sofa, trembling, repeating "Stupid people, foolish people"
He immediately went to apologize to Khobotov
He wrote a letter of resignation
reading.correct: He lay on the sofa, trembling, repeating "Stupid people, foolish people"
reading.explain: The text says he "лег на диван и долго еще повторял «Тупые люди, глупые люди»".

reading.ru: Доктор всю ночь не мог уснуть от стыда и досады на себя, а утром часов в десять отправился в почтовую контору и извинился перед почтмейстером.
reading.question: What did Andrei Yefimych do the next morning out of shame?
options: He went to the post office and apologized to the postmaster
He visited Ivan Dmitrich to apologize
He wrote a letter to the town council
reading.correct: He went to the post office and apologized to the postmaster
reading.explain: The text says he "отправился в почтовую контору и извинился перед почтмейстером".

reading.ru: «Кто старое помянет, тому глаз вон».
reading.question: What forgiving proverb does Mikhail Averyanych offer the doctor?
options: "Let bygones be bygones" (lit. whoever recalls the old, loses an eye)
"A friend in need is a friend indeed"
reading.correct: "Let bygones be bygones" (lit. whoever recalls the old, loses an eye)
reading.explain: Mikhail Averyanych says the Russian proverb "Кто старое помянет, тому глаз вон".

reading.ru: Вы живете в самой неблагоприятной обстановке.
reading.question: What does Mikhail Averyanych say about the doctor's living conditions?
options: That he lives in the most unfavorable circumstances
That his house is too luxurious
That he lives too far from the hospital
That his rent is too high
reading.correct: That he lives in the most unfavorable circumstances
reading.explain: Mikhail Averyanych tells him "Вы живете в самой неблагоприятной обстановке".

reading.ru: Болезни нет никакой, а просто я попал в заколдованный круг, из которого нет выхода.
reading.question: How does Andrei Yefimych describe his own condition to the postmaster?
options: That he has no illness but is caught in an enchanted circle with no way out
reading.correct: That he has no illness but is caught in an enchanted circle with no way out
reading.explain: He says "Болезни нет никакой, а просто я попал в заколдованный круг, из которого нет выхода".

reading.ru: А я к вам по делу, коллега. Пришел приглашать вас. Не хотите ли со мной на консилиум, а?
reading.question: What does Khobotov invite Andrei Yefimych to do?
options: Join him for a medical consultation
reading.correct: Join him for a medical consultation
reading.explain: Khobotov says "Не хотите ли со мной на консилиум" (Would you like to join me for a consultation).

reading.ru: Он рад был случаю загладить вчерашнюю вину и помириться.
reading.question: Why was Andrei Yefimych glad about Khobotov's invitation?
options: It gave him a chance to make amends for yesterday's incident
It meant he would earn extra money
It meant he could avoid Mikhail Averyanych
It gave him an excuse to leave town
reading.correct: It gave him a chance to make amends for yesterday's incident
reading.explain: The text says he "рад был случаю загладить вчерашнюю вину и помириться".

reading.ru: Тут у одного произошло осложнение со стороны легких», сказал в полголоса Хоботов, входя с Андреем Ефимовичем в палату.
reading.question: What excuse does Khobotov give for bringing Andrei Yefimych to the ward?
options: A patient supposedly had a lung complication
reading.correct: A patient supposedly had a lung complication
reading.explain: Khobotov says "у одного произошло осложнение со стороны легких" as a pretext.

reading.ru: «Пожалуйста, одеваться, Ваше Высокоблагородие», — сказал он тихо.
reading.question: What does Nikita tell Andrei Yefimych to do when he enters carrying a robe and clothes?
options: To sit and wait for Khobotov
reading.correct: To get dressed (in hospital clothes)
reading.explain: Nikita says "Пожалуйста, одеваться, Ваше Высокоблагородие" (Please get dressed, Your Excellency).

reading.ru: Андрей Ефимович все понял.
reading.question: What does Andrei Yefimych realize when he sees Nikita with the hospital clothes?
options: That he himself is now being committed as a patient
That the patient with lung problems needed him
reading.correct: That he himself is now being committed as a patient
reading.explain: The short sentence "Андрей Ефимович все понял" marks his realization that he is now a patient himself.

reading.ru: а от халата пахло копченой рыбой.
reading.question: What did the hospital robe smell like?
reading.correct: Smoked fish
reading.explain: The text notes "от халата пахло копченой рыбой" (the robe smelled of smoked fish).

reading.ru: Он опять прошелся. «Это какое-то недоразумение», — проговорил он, разводя руками в недоумении.
reading.question: What does Andrei Yefimych keep telling himself about his situation?
options: That it's all some kind of misunderstanding
reading.correct: That it's all some kind of misunderstanding
reading.explain: He repeats "Это какое-то недоразумение" (This is some sort of misunderstanding).

reading.ru: «Ага...» И вас засадили сюда, голубчик, проговорил он сиплым с просонок голосом, зажмурив один глаз.
reading.question: How does Ivan Dmitrich react upon waking and seeing the doctor in a patient's robe?
options: He mocks him for now being locked up too
He apologizes for his past outbursts
He panics and calls for help
reading.correct: He mocks him for now being locked up too
reading.explain: Ivan Dmitrich says mockingly "И вас засадили сюда, голубчик" (So they've locked you up here too, my friend).

reading.ru: Проклятая жизнь, проворчал он.
reading.question: What does Ivan Dmitrich grumble about life?
reading.correct: That it's a cursed life
reading.explain: Ivan Dmitrich mutters "Проклятая жизнь" (Cursed life).

reading.ru: Недалеко от больничного забора в ста сажениях, не больше, стоял высокий белый дом, обнесенный каменной стеною.
reading.question: What building does Andrei Yefimych see from the window, not far from the hospital fence?
reading.correct: The town prison
reading.explain: The text identifies this tall white walled building as "Это была тюрьма" (the prison).

reading.ru: отчаяние вдруг овладело им, он ухватился обеими руками за решетку и изо всей силы потряс ее.
reading.question: What does Andrei Yefimych do in a moment of despair by the window?
options: He grabs the window bars with both hands and shakes them with all his strength
He falls to his knees and prays
reading.correct: He grabs the window bars with both hands and shakes them with all his strength
reading.explain: The text says "он ухватился обеими руками за решетку и изо всей силы потряс ее".

reading.ru: Никита быстро отворил дверь, грубо обеими руками и коленом отпихнул Андрея Ефимовича, потом размахнулся и ударил его кулаком по лицу.
reading.question: How does Nikita respond when Andrei Yefimych and Ivan Dmitrich demand to be let out?
options: He shoves Andrei Yefimych and punches him in the face
He unlocks the door for them
reading.correct: He shoves Andrei Yefimych and punches him in the face
reading.explain: Nikita "отпихнул Андрея Ефимовича, потом размахнулся и ударил его кулаком по лицу".

reading.ru: В самом деле во рту было солено.
reading.question: What physical sensation confirms to Andrei Yefimych that he has been struck hard?
options: A salty taste in his mouth (from blood)
reading.correct: A salty taste in his mouth (from blood)
reading.explain: The text says "во рту было солено" — likely blood from his teeth.

reading.ru: Как могло случиться, что в продолжении больше, чем двадцати лет он не знал и не хотел знать этого?
reading.question: What realization strikes Andrei Yefimych after being beaten, about his patients' suffering?
options: That for over twenty years he never knew or wanted to know their pain
That the hospital should be rebuilt
reading.correct: That for over twenty years he never knew or wanted to know their pain
reading.explain: He realizes he never understood "такую же точно боль" his patients endured, wondering how in twenty years he never knew or wanted to know.

reading.ru: Под вечер Андрей Ефимович умер от апоплексического удара.
reading.question: How does Andrei Yefimych die?
reading.correct: From an apoplectic stroke
reading.explain: The text states plainly "Андрей Ефимович умер от апоплексического удара".

reading.ru: Стадо оленей, необыкновенно красивых и грациозных, о которых он читал вчера, пробежало мимо него.
reading.question: What vision passes before Andrei Yefimych as he dies?
options: A herd of beautiful, graceful deer he had read about
reading.correct: A herd of beautiful, graceful deer he had read about
reading.explain: As he dies, "Стадо оленей, необыкновенно красивых и грациозных ... пробежало мимо него".

reading.ru: Пришли мужики, взяли его за руки и за ноги и отнесли в часовню.
reading.question: What happened to Andrei Yefimych's body after he died?
options: Peasants carried him by his arms and legs to the chapel
He was buried immediately without ceremony
His body was sent to another town
reading.correct: Peasants carried him by his arms and legs to the chapel
reading.explain: The text says "Пришли мужики, взяли его за руки и за ноги и отнесли в часовню".

reading.ru: На похоронах были только Михаил Аверьянович и Дарьюшка.
reading.question: Who attended Andrei Yefimych's funeral?
options: Only Khobotov and the hospital staff
reading.correct: Only Mikhail Averyanych and Daryushka
reading.explain: The final line states "На похоронах были только Михаил Аверьянович и Дарьюшка".
